		<headline>Xiangshan County Meteorological Observatory issues a yellow warning for strong winds [Level III/Severe]</headline>
		<description>The Xiangshan County Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for strong winds at 06:36 on October 27, 2026: Due to the influence of cold air, it is expected that there will be 7-9 level northerly winds on the coastal sea surface of our county today, and 6-8 level winds in coastal towns and townships (streets) such as Hepu, Shipu, Gaotang Island, Dongchen, Tuci, Juexi, and Xianxiang. Please pay attention to preventing the adverse effects of strong winds on maritime transportation, fishery production, agricultural facilities, etc.</description>
		<instruction>1. The government and relevant departments should pay timely attention to the dynamics of warning signals and carry out emergency measures to defend against strong winds in accordance with relevant regulations; 2. Safety precautions should be taken for transportation facilities such as construction sites and ports. Water operations and passing ships in relevant water areas should closely monitor the dynamics of strong winds and seek shelter in safe areas or take effective measures to resist them; 3. Personnel in dangerous areas should evacuate in a timely manner and stop high-altitude operations; 4. Personnel should try to minimize going out and properly place window sills, balconies, and outdoor storage items.</instruction>
		<area>
			<areaDesc>Xiangshan County</areaDesc>
			<geocode>
				<valueName>CPEAS Geographic Code</valueName>
				<value>330225102000</value>
			</geocode>
		</area>
	</info>
	<info>
		<language>zh-CN</language>

		<headline>象山县气象台发布大风黄色预警[Ⅲ级/较重]</headline>
		<description>象山县气象台2026年10月27日06时36分发布大风黄色预警信号：受冷空气影响，预计今天我县沿海海面有7～9级偏北大风，鹤浦、石浦、高塘岛、东陈、涂茨、爵溪、贤庠等沿海镇、乡（街道）6～8级。请注意防范大风对海上交通、渔业生产、农业设施等的不利影响。</description>
		<instruction>1.政府及相关部门及时关注预警信号动态，根据相关规定做好防御大风应急工作； 2.建筑工地及港口等交通设施等采取安全防范措施，相关水域水上作业和过往船舶应密切关注大风动态，到安全区域避风或采取有效措施进行防抗； 3.危险地带人员及时撤离，停止高空作业； 4.人员尽量减少外出，妥善安置窗台、阳台及室外搁置物。</instruction>
		<area>
			<areaDesc>西周镇</areaDesc>
			<geocode>
				<valueName>CPEAS Geographic Code</valueName>
				<value>330225102000</value>
			</geocode>
		</area>
	</info>
</alert>
